body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm a data scientist with 4+ years delivering in-depth analyses and predictive models that directly shape product decisions -- and I'm applying for the Senior Data Scientist role at Age of Learning.

Age of Learning builds educational products that help kids learn to read and do math, with data science as a core driver of what content to serve, when, and to whom. That's the kind of high-impact, product-connected data science role where I do my best work.

What I'd bring on day one: I know how to own the full analytics lifecycle -- from defining data capture requirements and verifying data integrity, through predictive modeling and in-depth analysis, to visualization and stakeholder communication that actually drives decisions. At Community Dreams Foundation, I built a product metrics framework from scratch covering task completion, deflection rate, accuracy, and latency, then ran in-depth root cause analyses that drove a 22% accuracy improvement over three product iterations. At Kameleon, I delivered customer segmentation models (K-means, RFM) and churn prediction models (survival analysis, gradient boosting) that fed directly into retention campaigns, lifting 90-day retention by 12-15%.

The work I'd point to as most directly relevant: the churn prediction system at Kameleon -- identifying which users are at risk, why, and when to intervene -- maps cleanly to predicting which students are struggling and what content would re-engage them. Same problem structure, different domain.

I'm the kind of hire who can go deep on analysis and come back with a clear business recommendation. My portfolio is at rohitananthan.info if you want to see how I think through problems end to end.

Would love to connect.

Rohit Ananthan
rohitananthan123@gmail.com  |  linkedin.com/in/rohit-ananthan  |  rohitananthan.info
